in_english.name: AlJabbaroon
in_english.meaning: The greatest amount, the most powerful, the ruler over all, the one who holds the highest opinion
in_english.long_meaning: The name AlJabbaroon is derived from the Arabic root "J-B-R", which means the greatest amount, the most powerful, the ruler over all, the one who holds the highest opinion. This name is used to describe Allah's power and authority as the Lord of the universe. In Islamic tradition, this name is considered one of the most majestic and awe-inspiring names of Allah. It is often used in conjunction with other names such as Al-Aziz (The Mighty) and Al-Rahman (The Most Merciful).
